summary: A GitHub Actions pipeline that builds, tests and scans a small web API (secrets, SAST, dependencies, container image) and deploys to Azure only when every gate passes.
title: Automated DevSecOps CI/CD pipeline with security gates

summary: Terraform + Ansible provision and harden a multi-node Minecraft/web server on Azure with key-only SSH, Fail2ban, firewalling, non-root containers, a Cowrie honeypot and automatic instance repair.
title: Self-healing hardened server infrastructure as code

summary: An isolated container sandbox that executes a submitted file, captures process, file and network behaviour with auditd, and emits a JSON threat verdict — exercised only with benign samples and simulators.
title: Automated malware analysis sandbox

summary: A Python tool using the Azure SDK and Microsoft Graph that audits storage exposure, open management ports, MFA coverage and over-privileged identities, and alerts via Discord/Slack webhooks when a non-compliant resource appears.
title: Cloud zero-trust secrets and network audit tool
